method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, replay of every domain and interpretation-agreement clause, and exact formula, macro, controlled-token, identifier and reference comparison. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Substructures and their extensions for a fixed language, including the relation-only special case.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A structure whose domain is contained in another structure's domain counts as a part only when the two structures also agree on the language-symbol interpretations over the shared smaller domain.
samples.checks: Domain inclusion is retained as necessary but explicitly insufficient, and the shared-domain interpretation condition is preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: For structures in one language, M is a substructure of M-prime and M-prime an extension of M exactly when the domains are included, constants agree, function values agree on every tuple from M, and predicate membership agrees on every such tuple.
samples.checks: The direction of the substructure symbol and all four clauses, including arities and tuple scopes, are exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: If the language has no constants or function symbols, every subset N of M's domain determines the substructure with domain N by restricting each predicate interpretation to N to the n-th power.
samples.checks: The no-constant/no-function hypothesis, arbitrary subset, new domain and relation restriction equation are retained.

source_observations: MR-P120 directly attests उपसंरचना and MR-P121 attests the mathematical extension stem वर्धन; T273 records the edition-normalized pair उपरचना / वर्धित रचना.
The translation keeps domain extension distinct from the signature expansion defined in OLP-0184.
All formulas, macros, controlled tokens, identifiers and references match the frozen source exactly.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The exact full pair उपरचना / वर्धित रचना is not directly attested in a checked Marathi model-theory source and remains expert-reviewable.
The frozen source leaves an editorial comment asking for a proof or examples; no content was invented to answer it.
No TeX reader build was run for this individual unit.
